title: Information security risk assessment
instructions: The current risk register and the risk assessment methodology document. The register must show risk owners, likelihood and impact ratings, and the date of the last review (within the past 12 months).

title: Statement of Applicability
instructions: The approved Statement of Applicability (SoA) covering all 93 Annex A controls, with the justification for each inclusion or exclusion, version number and approval signature.

title: Internal audit report
instructions: The most recent internal ISMS audit report and the audit programme for the year. Include the auditor's independence statement and the list of findings raised.

title: Management review minutes
instructions: Minutes of the last management review meeting, showing the required inputs were discussed (audit results, risk status, objectives, incidents) and the decisions and actions agreed.

title: Corrective action log
instructions: The nonconformity and corrective action log for the audit period, showing root cause, action owner, due date and closure evidence for each item.

title: Information security policy
instructions: The current information security policy and topic-specific policies, with version history, approval by top management and evidence they were communicated to staff (e.g. intranet page or email).

title: Asset inventory
instructions: Export of the asset inventory (hardware, software, cloud services and information assets) with an owner assigned to each asset. The export date must be visible.

title: Quarterly access review
instructions: The last two quarterly access reviews for production systems and the HR system: who reviewed, which accounts were removed or changed, and the sign-off date.

title: Supplier security assessments
instructions: The supplier register with risk ratings, and completed security assessments (questionnaire or SOC 2 / ISO certificate review) for the three highest-risk suppliers.

title: Incident response plan and log
instructions: The incident response plan, plus the incident log for the audit period with severity, timeline and lessons learned for each incident. Include the record of the last tabletop exercise.

title: Business continuity test
instructions: The ICT continuity plan and the report from the most recent continuity or disaster recovery test, including RTO/RPO targets and whether they were met.

title: Legal and regulatory register
instructions: The register of legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security (e.g. DPDP Act, GDPR, customer contracts), with the date it was last reviewed.

title: Background screening records
instructions: Screening confirmation for five employees hired during the audit period (sample chosen by the auditor). Redact personal details; the screening date and outcome must be visible.

title: Security awareness training completion
instructions: Training platform report showing security awareness completion for all employees in the audit period, with the completion rate and the list of anyone overdue.

title: Leaver access removal
instructions: Offboarding checklists for three leavers from the audit period showing all access removed within 24 hours of the leaving date, with timestamps from the identity provider.

title: Physical entry controls
instructions: Office badge access logs for one sampled week and the visitor log for the same week. Include the current list of people with server room access.

title: Multi-factor authentication enforcement
instructions: Screenshot of the identity provider admin console showing MFA enforced for all users, including administrators. The date must be visible.

title: Vulnerability management
instructions: The latest vulnerability scan summary for production, the most recent penetration test report, and evidence that critical findings were fixed within the agreed timeframe.

title: Backup and restore test
instructions: Backup configuration and schedule for production databases, plus the record of the most recent successful restore test with its date and scope.

title: Security logging and monitoring
instructions: Configuration showing security logs are collected centrally with the retention period, and a sample alert from the audit period showing how it was triaged.

title: Encryption at rest and in transit
instructions: Evidence that production databases and storage are encrypted at rest (cloud console screenshots) and that public endpoints only accept TLS 1.2 or higher (e.g. an SSL Labs report).

title: Change management approvals
instructions: Pull request or change ticket records for 10 production changes sampled by the auditor, each showing peer review, approval and successful deployment.
